chunks: When Adam's (AS) children were presented to him, he looked at Dawud (AS) and was impressed by him, so he gave him fifty years from his own lifespan. He said: And Jibreel and Mikaeel descended to him, and the Angel of Death wrote a promissory note upon him for the fifty years. When death came to Adam (AS), the Angel of Death was sent to him and Adam (AS) said: 'There are still fifty years remaining from my lifespan.' He (the Angel) said: 'Then where are the fifty years that you gave to your son Dawud?'
He (the Imam) said: He had either forgotten it or denied it. So Jibreel and Mikaeel (AS) descended and both testified against him, and the Angel of Death took his soul.
Then Abu Abdillah (AS) said: 'It was the first promissory note written in the world.'

key_terms.أَنْكَرَهَا: Denied or refused to acknowledge; a legal term denoting denial of a prior obligation, which is why angelic testimony was required to establish the truth
key_terms.صَكّ: Promissory note or written legal document; here identified as the first written contract in human history, conferring sacred precedent to written agreements in Islamic jurisprudence
key_terms.مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ: The Angel of Death (Azrael in some traditions), the divine agent who takes souls at their appointed time and here acts as a formal witness and record-keeper

ai.seo_question: What was the first promissory note written in the world according to Imam al-Sadiq in Al-Kafi, and how does it relate to the story of Adam and Dawud?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted by Imam al-Sadiq (AS) through a chain that includes the prominent scholar Ali ibn Mahziyar, narrates how Adam (AS), upon seeing his descendants, was so impressed by Dawud (Prophet David) that he voluntarily gave him fifty years of his own lifespan. The archangels Jibreel and Mikaeel witnessed this gift, and the Angel of Death formalized it with a written promissory note (sakk). At the moment of Adam's death, when he appeared to forget or deny this agreement, Jibreel and Mikaeel descended as witnesses and testified against him, confirming the transfer. Imam al-Sadiq identifies this divine transaction as the very first written legal document in the history of the world, grounding the Islamic legal tradition of written contractual obligations in the earliest primordial human history.
word_analysis: and he was impressed by him

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Isa Bin Ayoub, from Ali Bin Mahziyar, from the one who mentioned it, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘When there were presented to Adam<sup>as</sup>, his<sup>as</sup> children, he<sup>as</sup> looked at Dawood. So he<sup>as</sup> marvelled at him<sup>as</sup>. So he<sup>as</sup> increased fifty years for him<sup>as</sup>, from his<sup>as</sup> own age. And Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> and Mikaeel<sup>as</sup> descended unto him, so the Angel of Death wrote a promissory note upon him, with fifty years. So when the death presented itself to him<sup>as</sup>, the Angel of Death descended unto him<sup>as</sup>. So Adam<sup>as</sup> said: ‘(But) there remain fifty years from my<sup>as</sup> age’. He said, ‘So what about the fifty (years) you<sup>as</sup> had made it to be for your<sup>as</sup> son<sup>as</sup> Dawood<sup>as</sup>?’

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But, he<sup>as</sup> had forgotten it, or denied it. So Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> and Mikaeel<sup>as</sup> descended, so they both testified against him, and the Angel of death captured him<sup>as</sup>’.
So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It was the first promissory note written in the world’.
en.sarwar: 2. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from ‘Isa ibn Ayyub from Afi ibn Mahziyar from those whom he has mentioned who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that when Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was shown his offspring, he looked at Dawud, he liked him and donated fifty years of his life to him. He (the Imam) said that Jibril and Michael came to him and the angel of death wrote a document about fifty years of his life being donated. When the time of his death came the angel of death came and Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said that fifty years of his life still has remained, and he said, ‘What about fifty years that you donated to your son Dawud ?
5 He (the Imam) said, ‘It was because that he had forgotten or denied it. Jibril and Michael came and testified about the matter, then the angel of death took away his soul .
5 Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘It was the first check (certificate or deed) that was ever written on earth. 5 ”
